versions.changelog:
commit-tidy v0.7.3

- Removed skill-card.md to streamline documentation.
- Updated CHANGELOG.md and message-discipline.md for improved clarity and up-to-date information.
- No functional changes to skill logic.

commit-tidy 0.7.2

- Added mandatory `commit-tidy` invocation before first push on branches with two or more Red→Green (test-fail→pass) cycles, even if only one file is affected.
- Expanded "Mandatory Invocation Gate" documentation to clarify process for repeated test-driven development cycles.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- General editorial updates for consistency in skill documentation.

- Removed the obsolete file: skill-card.md
- Updated CHANGELOG.md to reflect recent changes
- No changes to core functionality or usage documented
- Maintains all existing commit tidy rules and procedures

- Added conflict-commit-review feature for per-chunk review and gating of commits with conflict-residue in messages.
- Enforced a new HARD STOP: all commit squash, reword, or reorder plans now require scanning commit messages for merge/conflict residue and hunk-by-hunk review if found.
- Updated documentation and guidance to include the conflict-commit-review process and triggers.
- Added conflict-commit-review.md guide; removed outdated skill-card.md.
- Minor clarifications and reorganization in SKILL.md.

commit-tidy 0.6.0

- Updated documentation: revised CHANGELOG.md and staging-discipline.md for clarity and accuracy.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- No functional changes to core logic.

commit-tidy v0.5.5

- Added a new "Mandatory Invocation Gate" (HARD STOP): commit-tidy must be invoked before committing if 5+ files are changed or multiple components are edited.
- Updated SKILL.md and CHANGELOG.md documentation with clarifications on mandatory usage and review steps in large or cross-directory modifications.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

commit-tidy v0.5.4

- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Updated CHANGELOG.md and staging-discipline.md for documentation and rule clarifications.
- No functional or behavior changes to core skill logic.

commit-tidy v0.5.2

- Added dependency on the 'cleanup' skill in SKILL.md.
- Introduced new "Reset & Rollback Commit Tidy Rule" section to enforce single clean initial commits after reset/rollback.
- Updated criteria and instructions in SKILL.md for handling resets, rollbacks, and initial repository setup.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.
- General documentation and maintenance updates.

commit-tidy 0.5.1

- Enforces full-range squash analysis: when a squash candidate is detected or specified, scans the entire unpushed history (not just user-named ranges) for similar single-file commit patterns before proposing a squash plan.
- Adds a clear "Squash-scan scope (HARD STOP)" policy and references to the related procedure for staging discipline.
- Removes skill-card.md.
- Documentation improved in SKILL.md and sub-guides for stricter, more holistic squash/split recommendations.
- Minor structural/documentation clarifications across guides.

commit-tidy 0.5.0 adds non-interactive hunk splitting and workflow trigger enhancements.

- Added "hunk-split" guide: details single-hunk staging using git apply --cached.
- Added resources/commit-review-trigger.sh for commit review automation.
- Expanded SKILL.md topics and usage notes to include hunk-split and non-interactive staging scenarios.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Updated documentation for improved guidance and new features.

- Refined guides for message-discipline and staging-discipline to clarify commit message structure and file staging best practices.
- Updated documentation to clearly describe when and how to apply split and squash commit strategies.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file to streamline documentation.

commit-tidy v0.4.2

- Minor formatting update in SKILL.md: changed the separator for the YAML description block from `>-` to `|` for improved readability.
- No changes to logic or feature set.
- Content and instructions remain unchanged.

commit-tidy 0.4.1

- Improved commit message scaffolding: recommended commit bodies now follow the structure defined in message-discipline.md, with free-form body text by default.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- Documentation updates across message-discipline.md, soft-reset-amend.md, and staging-discipline.md for clarity on split/squash guidance and message conventions.
- Added explicit instructions for running local commit-type rule checks before executing recommended commit splits.
- Refined squash recommendation section with clearer output examples and messaging best practices.

Version 0.4.0

- Introduced three new topic guides: message-discipline, security-scan, and staging-discipline.
- Expanded the SKILL.md topics table to include commit message enforcement, security scan for secrets, and staging area discipline.
- Updated descriptions to clarify use cases, including commit message checks and public repo secret scanning.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- Enhanced instructions and topic coverage; core recommendations and split/squash logic remain consistent.

- Added interactive-amend and soft-reset-amend guides for advanced commit rewriting workflows.
- Expanded usage instructions and criteria to cover both uncommitted and committed changes, including handling of change ranges.
- Improved documentation structure with a new Topics section and linked guides.
- Replaced skill-card.md with comprehensive CHANGELOG.md and LICENSE files.

- Added basic metadata (author, version) to SKILL.md.
- No changes to logic, examples, or recommendations.
- Documentation content and usage instructions are unchanged.
